create_gaudi_rotary_embedding: create a GaudiRotaryEmbedding instance with a model config for HPU-accelerated rotary position embeddings
initialize_gaudi_rope_with_kwargs: initialize GaudiRotaryEmbedding using dim, base, max_position_embeddings, and rope_type keyword arguments directly
forward_gaudi_rotary_embedding: call forward on GaudiRotaryEmbedding with input tensor and sequence length to get cos and sin cached embeddings
set_cos_sin_cache: call _set_cos_sin_cache on GaudiRotaryEmbedding to precompute and register cosine and sine caches for a given sequence length
dynamic_frequency_update: call _dynamic_frequency_update on GaudiRotaryEmbedding to recompute inverse frequencies when sequence length grows beyond the cached limit
